name: The Cage

features.name: Roundhouse Kick
features.description: A near-miss feature for matching symbols.

review:
The Cage is a fight-night slot on a 3-4-3-4-3-4-3 grid with 5,184 ways and cascading wins. Wild Knockout xBombs explode in a cross pattern around themselves, and Roundhouse Kick is triggered when three to six of the same symbol line up without a win.

Nolimit rates it High volatility, with a 25,000x cap and a high 32% hit rate.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
